turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's not waste them. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and why did I find out from his phone?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, Hale, and tell me who decided it and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? Same team means the zero comes off and Owen hears an apology, so tell me what you have, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, that Owen receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing and was still demanding the zero withdrawn and an apology.
What moved her: nothing.
